query_text: what temperature can food be accepted at

messages.content: what temperature can food be accepted at

message.content:
Food is generally considered **safe to accept** if it is **cold at 40°F (4°C) or below** or **hot at 140°F (60°C) or above**.[3][1]

If food is **perishable** and has been between **40°F and 140°F** for **2 hours or more**, it should be discarded; if the air temperature is above **90°F**, that limit is **1 hour**.[3][4][1]

If you meant **cooked food’s safe internal temperature**, common minimums are **145°F for whole cuts of beef/pork/lamb/veal**, **160°F for ground meats**, and **165°F for poultry**.[5][1]
